notes: Granularity limit of the ledger gate (mechanism, not a forgery finding): ledger_corroborates() binds only (session_id, subagent_type). The 7 rows include 3 loop1 forks that were superseded by the loop2 re-evaluation, and the gate cannot distinguish which specific fork corroborates the final report, nor whether the returned verdicts were transcribed faithfully. record-audit-fork.py's own docstring states this boundary explicitly.

The PreToolUse guard (guard-confirmed-chapter-overwrite.py) protects system-spec/spec-state.json and confirmed chapters, but not the ledger path itself. The ledger's integrity therefore rests on the shape/timestamp/birth-vs-mtime evidence above rather than on a write guard.

The `cwd` field varies across ledger rows (3 rows at .../wt-21, 4 at .../plugins/system-spec-harness). This is consistent with the hook recording the payload cwd observed at fork time and is not by itself an anomaly, but I could not independently confirm the cwd transitions.
